insight.headline: Invalid Metafield Queries
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change starts in API version 2026-10. Previously, such queries would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their GraphQL queries to ensure they are filtering by valid metafields. They can check the metafield definitions in the Shopify admin to confirm which metafields are set up for filtering. This change may break existing queries, so thorough testing is necessary. The `metafield` object in the GraphQL Admin API should be reviewed for any changes.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants may notice more accurate results from apps using the GraphQL Admin API, as incorrect results due to invalid metafield queries will now be prevented.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the reliability and accuracy of data retrieved through the GraphQL Admin API, which is crucial for building robust and trustworthy Shopify apps.
insight.code_example: query { products(metafield: { key: "my_metafield", value: "my_value" }) { edges { node { title } } } }

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, instead of silently returning incorrect results, starting in API version 2026-10.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Apps can now subscribe to events for various topics, including metafield changes, using the Events API.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, making it easier to build theme pages.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, making it easier for app developers to build merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview is now available, providing early access to new inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
The CLI has been updated to fix a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, which may break existing apps.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2
updates.summary: The @shopify/cli-hydrogen package has been updated with non-interactive shop and storefront creation flags.

updates.title: Updated App Store requirements: 4.1.2 Use a unique name for your app
updates.summary: The App Store requirements have been updated to require unique app names, which may affect app developers.

updates.title: Storefront API `@inContext` supports `channelId`
updates.summary: The Storefront API @inContext directive now supports the channelId argument, allowing for more flexible queries.

updates.title: `productId`, `title`,`variantSku`, and `variantTitle` fields added to `ExchangeLineItem`
updates.summary: The ExchangeLineItem type now includes additional fields, such as productId, title, variantSku, and variantTitle.

updates.title: POS UI Extensions 2026-07 adds discount allocations to bundle components
updates.summary: The POS UI Extensions API now includes discount allocations to bundle components, providing more detailed cart line item data.

recap.headline: Enhanced GraphQL Admin API, Expanded Webhooks, and Improved Liquid Templates

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Updates
themes.detail: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, starting in API version 2026-10, ensuring more accurate results. This change affects how metafield filtering is handled, providing a more robust querying experience.

themes.title: Webhooks and Events Expansion
themes.detail: New metafield triggers and topics are available for Events, allowing apps to subscribe to a broader range of events including Order, Collection, and Location updates, as well as metafield changes on key resources like Product and Customer.

themes.title: Liquid Templates and App Development
themes.detail: Liquid templates have been enhanced to compose pages with blocks and partials more easily, simplifying theme development. Additionally, full-stack capabilities for app analytics have been introduced, streamlining the process of building merchant-facing analytics.

actions.text: Update GraphQL queries to handle new error responses for invalid metafield filtering
Explore new webhooks and events for integration into existing apps
Migrate theme development to utilize new Liquid template features
